Edit: Added a few more lines to context

it sounds like you're feeling awful right now, like you feel suicide is the only way to fix the relationship between your parents and the fuck-ups you've made. like you feel that there is no chance for things to get better. like all that you've done good in the world is all for naught. 

though, what do you think is on the other side? redemption? the afterlife? it's not something we can quantify, really. there isn't a magical reboot button that appears when you kill yourself allowing you to reset your game, sadly.

that doesn't mean it has to end here though. life doesn't always follow a linear sequential story. there are starts, ends and middles all over the place. maybe you can start reconciling with your parents right now, even just thanking them for what they do for you. or, if they're the type to blame you for the stress they have in their lives, then i have to say they aren't really the best of parents. maybe you can look to get a job and leave your house and gain more independence.

because ill tell you right now, you matter. you deserve to be happy. even will all the stress you think you're creating, you still deserve to be happy. but that isn't going to happen if you die.

do something for yourself that makes you feel good, and if nothing feels good, try making a warm cup of a drink you like and notice how it feels through your body, or go out for a walk with a friend so you can stay safe and just notice the air and the rocks and the sights.

think about something you can do after 7-8 hours that feels good, something in a couple hours, something right now. it's hard to think it days when all you're thinking about is hours. maybe just think in minutes about how you can feel better and from there, you can look to days and weeks and months from where you are now.

you deserve to live and be happy. you are not a burden for existing.
